nodes.speaker: sci
nodes.text: Time to pick a landing site! Jezero's ancient river delta is exciting. The flat plains are much safer.

variants.text: We are tired, and it is time to pick a site. Jezero's delta is exciting, but the flat plains are safer.

nodes.fact: NASA sent Perseverance to Jezero Crater because its delta was once a lake where tiny life could have lived.
